tickets.title: Verify cash distribution readiness
tickets.text:
Complete these checks before initiating or approving a cash distribution:
- Confirm requested gross or net distribution amount: $85,000
- Confirm source account and available cash: Teacup Comet Bank checking, $73,000 cash available
- Confirm destination instructions are already authorized or identify required authorization steps: [DESTINATION]
- Review tax withholding election or required withholding rules: [WITHHOLDING]
- Check for potential trading, liquidity, margin, or settlement constraints: [CONSTRAINTS]
- Confirm whether the distribution affects the financial plan, income strategy, or required minimum distribution tracking: [PLANNING IMPACT]

Review the $85,000 one‑time transfer and the $9,000 recurring transfer, assess cash on hand and whether selling municipal‑bond ladder or Copper Firefly Robotics shares is needed, and note any impact on the financial plan.

tickets.title: Follow up on policy renewal details
tickets.text: Contact the client or insurance professional to confirm renewal status, premium change, coverage changes, beneficiary updates needed, and any action required before the renewal window closes. Record received documents and route planning questions to the advisor. The Paper Otter Life annual premium notice shows a higher outlay than last year and the election window is closing; the household has not decided whether to pay from checking, reduce coverage, or request an in‑force illustration.
tickets.evidence: By September 4, 2026, the Paper Otter Life annual premium review needs follow-up because the notice shows a higher outlay than last year and a policy-election window closing soon; the household has not chosen whether to pay from checking, reduce coverage, or request an in-force illustration.
